race.comment: TAUTO BAR (7) wasn't far off them on debut at Ballarat Synthetic before an even effort at Pakenham Synthetic last start. Switches to turf first time for the Hayes yard and can improve. ANDRES GIRL (8) turned in a modest performance when fifth last time out over 1200m at Narrandera, beaten 3.5 lengths after being in contention on the bend. The maiden win prior was sound and she's got more experience (and is the only winner) than any of these. GLIDE (6) missed the frame on debut last start over 1213m at Sale after going forward early. The race experience will be invaluable. In the mix. MY LUMENESSA (9) next best on debut for the Brisbourne yard.
